routes.name: Work permit and temporary residence permit

note: Azerbaijan, read on the State Migration Service's own pages (migration.gov.az, 'Temporary and permanent residence', and 'Work permit', last updated 6 November 2025), which set out the Migration Code, on 2026-10-30. A temporary residence permit is issued by the Service on grounds that include holding a work permit for paid labour and engaging in entrepreneurship. The work permit is obtained by the employer, who may employ the foreigner only in its own working place (work for the sponsor); it is issued for one year (or the contract's shorter term) and extended a year at a time, the employer applying 30 days before expiry. Those engaged in entrepreneurship, and holders of permanent residence, need no work permit (work kept as any). The temporary residence permit is issued for up to one year (three for investors and highly skilled migrants) and extended each time for up to two. Where to apply: the foreigner applies to the Service at least 30 days before the end of the temporary stay or temporary residence, in person or through a representative, so the permit is asked in the country (in country); permanent residence is asked of the Service at least three months before the temporary residence permit ends (in country). Permanent residence is issued for five years and extended for five without limit. Permanent residence may be granted to one who has resided temporarily at least two years on the grounds of Articles 45.1.1 to 45.1.7, among which are entrepreneurs and highly qualified specialists; the page doesn't number its list of grounds, so which article entrepreneurship is isn't read and no years to permanence are kept on that route; work permit holders aren't among permanent residence's grounds. The route for highly qualified specialists in culture (on the inviting body's justified application) is a ground for both permits, but the page doesn't say what work it allows, so it isn't written. Art workers registered with the Ministry of Justice need no work permit (the work engine's matter). Decision times and fees follow the Law on State Fee, not read, so none are kept; naturalisation's years aren't on these pages. An earlier draft of this file (wave 8) was held because it said where to apply without a source saying so; the two sentences on applying are now quoted.

sources.title: State Migration Service of Azerbaijan, Temporary and permanent residence
sources.said: Permit for temporary residence on the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan is issued to foreigners and stateless persons by the State Migration Service of the Republic of Azerbaijan. ... In case they engage in entrepreneurship activity in the Republic of Azerbaijan; ... In case they obtain work permit in a way envisaged by this Code to carry out paid labor activity on the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan; ... foreigners and stateless persons should apply to the State Migration Service of the Republic of Azerbaijan to obtain a permit in this regard at least 30 days before the expiry of the temporary staying or temporary residence period. ... Foreigners and stateless persons apply in person or through their legal representatives for obtaining permit for temporary residence on the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan. ... Permit for temporary residence on the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan is issued for the period mentioned on the application of an applicant, but for the period not exceeding 1 year, except the cases set forth in Article 45.1.2 and 45.1.4-1 (concerning highly skilled migrants) of the Migration Code, and it can be extended each time for the period not exceeding 2 years, if there is a relevant ground. ... Foreigners and stateless persons should apply to the State Migration Service of the Republic of Azerbaijan in case of existence of grounds for issuance of permanent residence permit to them, at least 3 months before the expiry date of their permits for temporary residence on the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan. ... Permit for permanent residence in the Republic of Azerbaijan is issued for the period of 5 years. At least 3 months before the expiration of this period the permit issued for permanent residence can be extended for 5 years upon application of foreigner or stateless person. The number of extensions is not limited.

sources.title: State Migration Service of Azerbaijan, Work permit
sources.said: Work permit is issued for 1 year or in case the labour contract is concluded for a period of less than 1 year it is issued for that period. Validity period of the work permit can be extended each time for not more than 1 year ... For extension of validity period of work permit employer should submit an application to the State Migration Service at least 30 days prior to its expiration. ... The following foreigners and stateless persons are not required to obtain a work permit: ... those who possess permanent residence permit in the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan; ... those engaged in entrepreneurship activity in the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan; ... should employ foreigners and stateless persons only in their own working place ...
